tools.name: get_related_resources
tools.description: Use this tool after you have a resource id and need a related published item that the catalog already records: the next or previous lesson, the course page, the song and its watch page, or a shared category or coloring gallery. It does not guess semantic similarity.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_resource, list_products, get_learning_path · Private data: get_related_resources · Public sink: get_learning_path.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_resource, list_products, get_learning_path · Private data: get_related_resources · Public sink: get_learning_path

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
